# Data
Load libraries
```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, # spatial
               here, 
               tidyverse, 
               rio, # for importing
               table1, # make table1
               lubridate,
               ncf, #correlation
               xtable, # export table1
               fuzzyjoin, # joining with some inexact
               spdep, # regression spatial
               tmap, # spatial maps
               sjlabelled, # table 1 labels for sf
               geepack, # for regression
               lme4,
               terra,
               raster,
               exactextractr
               )
```

Read in data
```{r}
# ## Population of Mérida + Kanasín (old)
yuc_pop <- read.csv("RESAGEBURB2020 - 31 Yucatán.csv")

## Mérida + Kanasín shapefile from INEGI (eem - Block Polygons)
merida_block_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("31_yucatan_2020/conjunto_de_datos"),
                    layer = "31m")
merida_block_sf <- merida_block_sf %>% 
  filter(CVE_MUN == "041" | CVE_MUN == "050")

## Mérida + Kanasín shapefile from INEGI (eea - Basic Urban Geostatistical Areas)
merida_cluster_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("31_yucatan_2020/conjunto_de_datos"),
                    layer = "31a")
merida_cluster_sf <- merida_cluster_sf %>% 
  filter(CVE_MUN == "041" | CVE_MUN == "050")

## SINAVE case data
sinave_all_cases <- here::here("data", "SINAVE_Data", 
                       "datos_abiertos_dengue_061223.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

## Cases Shapefile
cases_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("data"), 
                 layer = "TIRS_SINAVE_22_23")

## Cases by TIRS block (not a shapefile, will add this info onto the shapefile)
cases_tirs_info <- read_csv("data/TIRS_SINAVE_combined22_23_blockID.csv")

## TIRS Clusters Shapefile
clusters_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("data"),
                    layer = "Cluster final 2021 actualizado")

# make sure all sf files have the same coordinates 
merida_cluster_sf <- st_transform(merida_cluster_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
cases_sf <- st_transform(cases_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
clusters_sf <- st_transform(clusters_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
```

## Some Cleaning
### update shapefiles 
to include extra data
```{r}
# Population Data
## add CVEGEO to population dataset
yuc_pop <- yuc_pop %>%
  mutate(CVE_ENT = as.character(ENTIDAD),
         CVE_MUN = paste0("0", MUN),
         CVE_LOC = paste0("000", LOC),
         CVE_AGEB = AGEB,
         CVE_MZA = ifelse(nchar(as.character(yuc_pop$MZA)) == 3,
                          as.character(MZA),
                          ifelse(nchar(as.character(yuc_pop$MZA)) == 2,
                                 paste0("0", MZA), paste0("00", MZA))),
         CVEGEO = paste0(CVE_ENT, CVE_MUN, CVE_LOC, CVE_AGEB, CVE_MZA))
yuc_pop <- yuc_pop[-c(1:3),]

## now add this population data into the shapefile to get a shapefile with pop
##   data
merida_block_sf <- merida_block_sf %>% 
  right_join(yuc_pop, by = c("CVEGEO", "CVE_ENT", "CVE_MUN",
                                     "CVE_LOC", "CVE_AGEB", "CVE_MZA"))

# Case Data
## Add TIRS blockid info to cases_sf so the sf now has TIRS id
cases_sf <- cbind(cases_sf, cases_tirs_info[,c("CVEGEO", "CVE_MZA", "CLUSTER", 
                                               "MZA3X3", "MZTIRS", "TIRS")])
```

### dengue 2023 cases only
```{r}
# select cases of all the CONFIRMED 2023 dengue cases
sinave_all_dengue <- sinave_all_cases %>% 
  # only want data for Mérida + Kanasín (050, 041 MUNICIPO_RES)
  filter(MUNICIPIO_RES == 50 | MUNICIPIO_RES == 41) %>% 
  # change symptom onset date to match cases dataset (i.e., weeks since 
  #  start of ABD season)
  mutate(Week_onset = ymd(FECHA_SIGN_SINTOMAS),
         Week_onset = epiweek(Week_onset),
         Year = year(FECHA_SIGN_SINTOMAS)) %>%
  relocate(c(FECHA_SIGN_SINTOMAS, Week_onset), .before = ID_REGISTRO) %>% 
  filter(ESTATUS_CASO == 2) %>%  # 1 likely; 2 confirmed; 3 discarded
  mutate(age_grp = as.factor(ifelse(EDAD_ANOS < 18, "Child", "Adult")))

# all DENV cases from the TIRS trial area
denv_cases_sf <- cases_sf %>% #674 cases
  filter((str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENV") | str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENGUE"))
         & Year == 2023) %>% # only dengue, only 2023 
  mutate(age_grp = as.factor(ifelse(Age < 18, "Child", "Adult")),
         TIRS = factor(TIRS, levels = c(0, 1), 
                       labels = c("Control", "TIRS Intervention")))
# only adult cases (< 18)
denv_adult_cases_sf <- denv_cases_sf %>%
  filter(Age >= 18)
# child dengue cases
denv_kid_cases_sf <- denv_cases_sf %>% 
  filter(Age < 18)
```

Number of dengue cases in 2023: `r nrow(denv_cases_sf)`
Number of adult dengue cases in 2023: `r nrow(denv_adult_cases_sf)` 
Number of child dengue cases in 2023: `r nrow(denv_kid_cases_sf)`

# Tables
Demographic info on the dengue cases
## (city) table1 for confirmed dengue cases in the entire city
```{r}
# sinave_all_dengue is all confirmed dengue cases in the city

## formatting
sinave_all_dengue$SEXO <- 
  factor(sinave_all_dengue$SEXO, levels = c(1, 2),
         labels = c("Female", "Male"))
sinave_all_dengue$SEXO <- setLabel(sinave_all_dengue$SEXO, "Sex")
sinave_all_dengue$EDAD_ANOS <- set_label(sinave_all_dengue$EDAD_ANOS, "Age")
sinave_all_dengue$Week_onset <- set_label(sinave_all_dengue$Week_onset, 
                                          "Week of Symptom Onset*")
footnote <- "*Week of the year"

## table
table1_city <- table1(~ EDAD_ANOS + SEXO + Week_onset | age_grp, data = sinave_all_dengue,
       render.continuous = c(.= "Mean (SD)", .="Median [Min, Max]",
                             .= "Median (Q1, Q3)"),
       footnote = footnote)
table1_city <- as.data.frame(table1_city)

## print table
print(xtable(table1_city, type = "latex"), file = "table1_city.tex")
```

## (tirs) table1 for confirmed dengue cases
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area

## formatting
denv_cases_sf$Age <- as.numeric(denv_cases_sf$Age)
denv_cases_sf$Age <- set_label(denv_cases_sf$Age, "Age")
denv_cases_sf$TIRS <- set_label(denv_cases_sf$TIRS, "Trial Arm")
denv_cases_sf$Week_onset <- set_label(denv_cases_sf$Week_onset, 
                                      "Week of Symptom Onset*")

## table
table1_tirs <- table1(~ Age + Week_onset + TIRS | age_grp, data = denv_cases_sf,
       render.continuous = c(.= "Mean (SD)", .="Median [Min, Max]",
                             .= "Median (Q1, Q3)"),
       footnote = footnote,
       render.missing = NULL)
table1_tirs <- as.data.frame(table1_tirs)

## print table
print(xtable(table1_tirs, type = "latex"), file = "table1_tirs.tex")
```

## proportions
```{r}
# add population info to clusters_sf
clusters_sf <- st_intersection(merida_block_sf, clusters_sf)

# Populations of each cluster + block
cluster_population <- clusters_sf %>% 
  group_by(CLUSTER) %>% 
  summarize(Cluster_Population = sum(POBTOT))
block_population <- clusters_sf %>% 
  group_by(CLUSTER, MZTIRS) %>% 
  summarize(Block_Population = sum(POBTOT))
```

Comparing proportion of cases within the study area vs the rest of the city?
```{r}
# All confirmed cases in Mérida caught by MOH / total population of Mérida
# sinave_all_dengue is all confirmed dengue cases in the city
nrow(sinave_all_dengue) / sum(merida_block_sf$POBTOT)

# trial area
# num cases in trial / total population of trial area
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area
nrow(denv_cases_sf) / sum(clusters_sf$POBTOT)
```
Number of dengue cases in city: `r nrow(sinave_all_dengue)`
Population of the city: `r sum(merida_block_sf$POBTOT)`
Number of dengue cases in trial area: `r nrow(denv_cases_sf) `
Population of the trial area: `r sum(clusters_sf$POBTOT)`


# Figures
## stacked bar plot
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area

ggplot(denv_cases_sf, aes(x = TIRS,fill = age_grp)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  labs(title = "Dengue cases in 2023 among adults and children, by trial arm",
       x = "Trial Arm",
       y = "Number of cases",
       fill = "Age group") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Adult" = "#DC3220", "Child" = "#005AB5"))
ggsave("denv_tirs_cases_stacked_bar.pdf")
```

## line graph adult and child denv cases within trial area
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area
## case counts
# All dengue 2023 cases, by age group
denv_adult_counts <- denv_adult_cases_sf %>% 
  count(Week_onset) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
denv_kid_counts <- denv_kid_cases_sf %>% 
  count(Week_onset) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

## plot
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = denv_adult_counts,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = n, color = "Adult")) + 
  geom_line(data = denv_kid_counts,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = n, color = "Child")) +
  labs(x = "Week of Symptom Onset",
       y = "Number of Cases",
       fill = "Location",
       title = "Dengue Cases for Adults and Children") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 53, by = 2)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adult" = "#DC3220", "Child" = "#005AB5"),
                     name = "Age Group")
ggsave("adult_children_line.pdf")
```

## line graph but rates instead of cases
```{r}
# change to rates
## i'm assuming the denominator stays the same over time?
## looking at those in the trial area
## ok why am i looking at rate
denv_adult_rates <- denv_adult_counts %>%
  mutate(rate = (n/sum(clusters_sf$POBTOT))*100000)
denv_kid_rates <- denv_kid_counts %>%
  mutate(rate = (n/sum(clusters_sf$POBTOT))*100000)

## plot
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = denv_adult_rates,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = rate, color = "Adult")) + 
  geom_line(data = denv_kid_rates,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = rate, color = "Child")) +
  labs(x = "Week of Symptom Onset",
       y = "Cases per 100,000 people",
       fill = "Location",
       title = "Rate of Dengue Cases for Adults and Children within the TIRS Trial Area") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 53, by = 2)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adult" = "#DC3220", "Child" = "#005AB5"),
                     name = "Age Group")
ggsave("adult_children_line_rates.pdf")
```

# Maps
## heatmap for number of cases
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area

## all cases (kids and adults) within each cluster
case_counts_per_cluster_all <- st_join(denv_cases_sf, clusters_sf, join = st_within) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  count(CLUSTER.x)

## add the case counts to cluster shapefile
clusters_sf$CLUSTER <- as.numeric(clusters_sf$CLUSTER)
clusters_cases <- clusters_sf %>% 
  left_join(case_counts_per_cluster_all, by = c("CLUSTER" = "CLUSTER.x"))

# plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = merida_cluster_sf, linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = clusters_cases, aes(fill = n), color = "white", 
          linewidth = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Cases") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmax), ## zooom in on cluster area
           ylim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymax), 
           expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## (cluster) heatmap for cases rate
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area
# case_counts_per_cluster_all is all cases (kids and adults) within each cluster

# cluster_population and block_population are all people in a cluster or block,
#   respectively
cluster_population <- cluster_population %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
block_population <- block_population %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(IDMZA = paste0(as.character(CLUSTER), as.character(MZTIRS)))

## add the population to cluster shapefile
cluster_population$CLUSTER <- as.numeric(cluster_population$CLUSTER)
block_population$IDMZA <- as.numeric(block_population$IDMZA)
clusters_rate <- clusters_cases %>% 
  left_join(cluster_population, by = "CLUSTER") %>% 
  left_join(block_population, by = c("IDMZA", "MZTIRS", "CLUSTER")) %>% 
  mutate(rate_cluster = (n/Cluster_Population) * 1000,
         rate_block = (n / Block_Population) * 10)

# rate by cluster
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = merida_cluster_sf, linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = clusters_rate, aes(fill = rate_cluster), color = "white", 
          linewidth = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Cases per 1000 people") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmax), 
           ylim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymax), 
           expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## (block) heatmap for cases rate
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = merida_cluster_sf, linewidth = 0.05) +
```
